n-k-k2-01.title: Claim about whole class
n-k-k2-01.goal: Use self-introductions as proof to decide whether sentence about everybody true, see how many exceptions disprove am, and write sentence wey fit evidence.
n-k-k2-01.material:
Your class get chat group and 4 students. Each write short food introduction. Then 수진 write sentence about class.

민호: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 매일 먹어요.
에밀리: 저는 김치를 안 좋아해요. 불고기를 좋아해요.
지아: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 그런데 매운 김치는 못 먹어요.
토마스: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 지난주에 처음 먹었어요.

수진: 우리 반 네 명은 모두 김치를 좋아해요.

(모두 = all.)
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.prompt: 수진 claim ALL 4 classmates like kimchi. Which classmate sentence show say claim no true?
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.hint.0: For each classmate, decide whether sentence tell you if person like kimchi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Keep only sentences wey directly answer ‘Does this person like kimchi?’ and compare dem with 수진 sentence.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.a: Eating am every day support claim; e no show say person dislike kimchi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.b: Read whole introduction: 지아 also say she like kimchi. She no fit eat spicy kimchi, but that no mean say she dislike kimchi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.d: Eating am first time last week no tell whether he like am.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.explain: Only 에밀리 answer ‘Do you like kimchi?’ with no. Claim about everybody fail with just one person disagreeing. Other sentences talk about how much, spiciness or when, no be whether dem like am.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.prompt: 수진 sentence say 모두 (all). How many of four classmates need disagree before her sentence false?
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Imagine say class get 100 students. How many people wey no like kimchi you need find?
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.hint.1: ‘All of dem like am’ true only if nobody left out. Count how many exceptions go break am.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.a: Two more than needed. ‘All’ make claim about every single person.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.c: Three more than needed. ‘All’ make claim about every single person.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.d: Four far more than needed. ‘All like am’ don fail once one person no like am.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.explain: ‘All’ promise something about every single person, so one exception enough to break am. Sentence like ‘대부분’ (most) fit allow some exceptions.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.prompt: Write ONE polite Korean sentence about kimchi and four classmates wey true based on their introductions.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.hint.0: First decide how many of four like kimchi, then write sentence wey true for exactly those people.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.hint.1: Check your sentence against 에밀리 introduction before finish.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: My sentence true for ALL four introductions, including 에밀리?
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I avoid saying ‘all’ unless I mention exception?
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: E count people instead of saying ‘all.’

n-k-k2-02.title: Note match di chat?
n-k-k2-02.goal: Compare written summary with original chat, find lines wey change detail, say what kind detail change, then write corrected summary.
n-k-k2-02.material:
민수 and 지나 plan Saturday through chat. Then 지나 write note for her mama.

민수: 지나 씨, 토요일 오후 두 시에 학교 앞에서 만나요.
민수: 영화는 세 시 반에 시작해요. 영화를 보고 저녁을 먹어요.
민수: 저녁을 먹고 아홉 시에 집에 가요.
지나: 네, 좋아요!

(앞 = in front of. 집에 가요 = go home.)
n-k-k2-02.prereq.0: Know Korean time words (두 시, 아홉 시)
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.prompt: 지나 write note for her mama. Some lines no match chat. Choose one line wey no match.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.hint.0: Check note one line at a time and find same detail in chat: who, which day, where, wetin time.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.hint.1: For each line, say whether chat give place or time and compare details one by one.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.explain: Two lines no match. Line 2 say dem meet in front of cinema, but 민수 write 학교 앞 (in front of school). Line 5 say 여덟 시 (8 o’clock), but 민수 write 아홉 시 (9 o’clock). Lines 1, 3 and 4 match.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.prompt: Wrong lines for note differ from chat in two ways. Which pair?
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sort plan details into groups: who, day, place, time.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.hint.1: Which two groups get details wey change between chat and note?
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.r.a: Day (토요일) same in chat and note.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.r.b: Person (민수) and day (토요일) same in chat and note.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.r.d: Person (민수) same in chat and note.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.explain: Note change where dem meet (영화관 instead of 학교) and time dem go home (여덟 시 instead of 아홉 시). Who and which day correct.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.prompt: Write note to mother again in correct polite Korean (2 or 3 short sentences). Use chat for meeting place, meeting time and time she go home.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.hint.0: First list three details: where dem meet, when dem meet, when she go home.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.hint.1: Copy each detail from 민수 messages and keep each time with its plan, then add polite endings (-요).
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Every place and time in my note match chat?
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: My mother go know where and when to expect me?

n-k-k2-03.title: Invitation with missing details
n-k-k2-03.goal: Compare written summary with original chat, find lines wey change details, name the kind of change, and write corrected summary.
n-k-k2-03.material:
Last week you meet 지호 in language class. Today he send message. You never visit his house before.

지호: 토요일에 우리 집에서 파티를 해요. 꼭 오세요!

(꼭 = please be sure to.)
n-k-k2-03.thinking.1: Separate needed from nice to know
n-k-k2-03.thinking.2: Vague answers wey look like answers
n-k-k2-03.prereq.0: Know basic question words (몇 시, 어디)
n-k-k2-03.prereq.2: Fit say ‘I will go’ and ‘thank you’ in simple polite Korean (갈게요, 고마워요), glossed in hints
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.prompt: You wan go. Which questions must you ask before you fit reach party? Choose everything wey you really need.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.hint.0: Imagine say na Saturday morning and you wan leave. Wetin fit stop you from leaving?
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.hint.1: Sort questions: which ones help you reach there, and which ones only nice to know?
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.b: Number of guests no change whether you fit find place or arrive on time.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.d: Useful and polite to ask, but you fit arrive without knowing am. E no necessary to get there.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.e: Knowing the occasion fit help you choose gift, but e no tell when or where to go.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.explain: Message give day (토요일) but no time, and 우리 집 no give address for person whose house you never visit. Time and place na the two facts you need to arrive.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.acc.0: Asking wetin to bring thoughtful and okay. E just no necessary to arrive at right place and time.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.prompt: 지호 answer your questions with only one line: ‘저녁에 오세요.’ You know enough about time now?
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Think how many hours 저녁 fit cover.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ask yourself: two guests fit read this sentence and arrive 3 hours apart?
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.a: Yes. 저녁 na time, so I fit come anytime for evening.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.a: 저녁 (evening) cover several hours. If you arrive late, you fit miss start; if early, nobody ready yet.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.b: Not yet. 저녁 cover several hours, so I still need exact time.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.c: Yes. I know day and part of day, so I fit plan when to arrive.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.c: Day and part of day still no give exact arrival time.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.d: Not yet. 저녁 mean ‘dinner,’ so I should ask whether dem serve food.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.d: 저녁 fit mean ‘evening’ or ‘dinner.’ Here na time word because of 에 and 오세요; food no tell you when to arrive.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.explain: 저녁 only name part of day. To arrive at right time, you still need hour, for example 여섯 시.
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.hint.0: Start by thanking am or saying you go come (고마워요 = thank you, 갈게요 = I will go).
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.hint.1: Which facts from your earlier questions must person know before leaving home? Ask for dem with polite ending (-요).
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I ask about BOTH time and place?
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: My reply polite enough for person I meet only last week?

n-k-k2-04.title: Basket with rules
n-k-k2-04.goal: Read different conditions in short shopping chat, then build more than one basket wey meet all, and report one basket in Korean.
n-k-k2-04.material:
민지: 오늘 시장에서 과일을 사요. 사과는 한 개에 천 원, 귤은 한 개에 오백 원이에요.
민지: 사과도 사고 귤도 사요. 그런데 사과가 귤보다 적어요.
민지: 과일은 모두 일곱 개 이상 사요. 오천 원을 넘으면 안 돼요.

(이상 = this number or more. 넘으면 안 돼요 = must not go over. -보다 = than.)
n-k-k2-04.prereq.0: Know numbers up to thousands (천, 오백)
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.prompt: For 민지 second message, wetin ‘사과가 귤보다 적어요’ tell you about basket?
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.hint.0: Find which fruit na subject (marked with 가) and which fruit dem compare am with (marked with 보다).
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.hint.1: Read 적어요 as ‘small amount’ and decide which fruit number smaller.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.o.a: There are more apples than tangerines.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.a: 적어요 mean ‘few / less’. -보다 mark thing wey you compare with, so apples be smaller number.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.o.b: There are as many apples as tangerines.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.b: Sentence compare two amounts and say one smaller; e no say dem equal.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.o.c: There are fewer apples than tangerines.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.o.d: There are no apples in basket.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.d: Line before say 사과도 사고, so apples dey in basket; 적어요 mean ‘fewer,’ no be ‘none.’
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.explain: A (사과가) B (귤보다) 적어요 mean A fewer than B. So apples less than tangerines.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.prompt: Someone suggest 3 apples and 5 tangerines. Which condition from 민지 messages this basket break?
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.hint.0: Check conditions one by one with numbers 3 and 5.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.hint.1: For money condition, calculate apple price and tangerine price separate, then add.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.b: 3 apples fewer than 5 tangerines, so this condition okay.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.c: 3 + 5 = 8 pieces of fruit, wey na 7 or more, so okay.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.d: Basket get both apples and tangerines, so okay.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.explain: 3 apples cost 3,000 won and 5 tangerines cost 2,500 won, total 5,500 won. E pass 5,000. Other three conditions okay.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.prompt: Find 3 different baskets wey meet EVERY condition in 민지 messages. a = number of apples (사과), t = number of tangerines (귤).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.0: First put conditions in your own words: apples fewer than tangerines, at least 7 pieces, no more than 5,000 won.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.1: Try 1 apple and find number of tangerines wey make at least 7 pieces; then check price.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.2: Check money last: 1,000 x apples + 500 x tangerines, then change apple amount.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c0: Buy whole pieces only (whole number of 개).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c1: 사과도 사고 귤도 사요 mean at least 1 of each.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c2: 사과가 귤보다 적어요 mean apples must be fewer than tangerines.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c3: 일곱 개 이상: at least 7 pieces of fruit altogether.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c4: Total pass 5,000 won (each apple 1,000, each tangerine 500).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.explain: For example, 1 apple + 7 tangerines = 4,500 won; 2 + 5 = 4,500 won; 3 + 4 = 5,000 won. Many baskets fit because messages give limits, no be one exact order.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.prompt: Choose ONE basket and tell 민지 in short polite message how many apples and tangerines you go buy and total price.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.hint.0: Choose one basket from list above and write its two numbers.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.hint.1: Say apples first, then tangerines, then total in won.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Numbers in my message match one basket I made?
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Total correct (1,000 x apples + 500 x tangerines)?

n-k-k2-05.title: Who did it? Sentence no talk
n-k-k2-05.goal: Follow short chat wey leave subjects out, notice how your guess about who do what change, then rewrite one sentence so nobody misread am.
n-k-k2-05.material: 하나 dey talk with her friend 준호 about last weekend. In Korean, people often leave subject out when context clear. Read slowly: story come in three parts.
n-k-k2-05.thinking.1: Change interpretation as new information arrive
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.prompt: Read each part, choose most likely meaning, then continue. Your answer fit change as you read more.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.hint.0: Decide using only wetin you don read so far.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Check which words name person and which verbs no have person connected to dem.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Second sentence no get subject. Korean often leave subject out when context clear, but here sibling (동생이) na last person mentioned and 하나 na speaker, so you no fit know sure yet.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Sentence say 만들었어요, so somebody make am, but only people in story na 하나 and her younger sibling.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Who most likely make bibimbap now?
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.after: 하나 probably make am herself, but she answer question about sibling cooking skill, so e still only likely.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: 하나 say her sibling no fit cook, so this unlikely, but she never say who cook yet.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: First part say 만들었어요 (made), so somebody cook am.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Her answer na about sibling cooking skill. E no say she cook together with am.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.after: 먹었어요 again no subject. Most likely 하나, maybe with her sibling. When person clearly marked (동생이 했어요), marker show who do am; when no marker, use context and sometimes ask.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: 하나 na person wey say 제가 만들었어요; nothing mark sibling alone as person wey eat am. 설거지는 동생이 get marker, but 먹었어요 no.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: 맛있게 먹었어요 mean say dem eat and enjoy am.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.reflect: Korean often leave out subject when context show am, but last person you read about no always do next action. Look for markers (이/가, 은/는, 제가) and keep options open if no marker. If e matter, ask.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.prompt: Rewrite 하나 first two sentences in polite Korean so nobody misunderstand who make bibimbap: 하나 herself, as chat show. Original: 어제 동생이 우리 집에 왔어요. 비빔밥을 만들었어요.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Compare your sentence with original: which information second sentence miss?
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Particle after person word (-가 / -이) show that person do action.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Reader fit know who make bibimbap without checking chat?
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I still say sibling come to my house?
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: E name person wey did NOT make am too.
